headline: Thousands of misconfigured Supabase databases found exposing user data
summary: Researchers found more than 16,000 misconfigured Supabase databases with readable tables exposing personally identifiable information, passwords or authentication tokens. Coverage links the exposures to AI-generated, "vibe-coded" apps that were not properly configured or secured.

claims.statement: Researchers found more than 16,000 misconfigured Supabase databases exposing readable tables with PII, passwords or authentication tokens.

sources.quote: Researchers found more than 16,000 misconfigured Supabase databases exposing readable tables with personally identifiable information, passwords, or authentication tokens.

claims.statement: Some Supabase customers are publicly exposing large amounts of people's data to the web.

sources.quote: Some Supabase customers are publicly exposing reams of people

sources.quote: The findings highlight how AI-generated and vibe-coded apps can spill and expose users
